news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update
news.summary: Tenax reported cash and cash equivalents of $118.0 million as of June 30, 2026 (aided by $13.4 million from warrant exercises during the quarter) and now expects that cash to fund operations through at least Q2 2028. R&D expenses rose to $12.9 million from $6.1 million a year earlier as the company confirmed it still expects topline Phase 3 LEVEL data in August 2026.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity initiates Tenax Therapeutics coverage with Buy rating, $35 price target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity started coverage of TENX with a Buy rating and a $35 price target, adding to a growing roster of sell-side analysts positioning ahead of the Phase 3 LEVEL data readout.

news.headline: Evercore ISI initiates Tenax Therapeutics stock coverage with outperform rating
news.summary: Evercore ISI began coverage of TENX with an Outperform rating and a $39 price target, assigning roughly a 50% probability of success to the Phase 3 LEVEL trial versus the 20-25% odds it says are priced into the stock. The firm sees 250% to 10x upside on positive data against significant downside if the trial fails.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Presentation of LEVEL Clinical Trial Data at ESC Congress 2026
news.summary: Tenax confirmed that topline Phase 3 LEVEL trial results for TNX-103 (oral levosimendan) in PH-HFpEF will be unveiled in a Late-Breaking Clinical Science session at the ESC Congress 2026 in Munich (August 28-31), presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah of Northwestern University. This pins the long-awaited data readout to a specific late-August window.

news.headline: Tenax and Orion secure long-term levosimendan supply deal, extend license through 2035
news.summary: Orion Corporation agreed to become the primary long-term manufacturer/supplier of oral levosimendan under a new five-year Supply Agreement with automatic renewals, and the parties amended their 2013 License Agreement to extend the deadline for U.S. regulatory approval to December 31, 2035.

news.headline: Guggenheim raises Tenax Therapeutics price target to $40, lifts trial success odds to 80%
news.summary: Guggenheim maintained its Buy rating on TENX and raised its price target to $40 from $34, increasing its probability-of-success estimate for the Phase 3 LEVEL trial to 80% from 75%. The firm noted Tenax is the only company running a Phase 3 trial in PH-HFpEF, a condition with no approved treatments.

catalysts.label: LEVEL Phase 3 topline data presented at ESC Congress 2026
catalysts.detail: A Late-Breaking Clinical Science session in Munich will present full topline results of the Phase 3 LEVEL trial of oral levosimendan (TNX-103) in PH-HFpEF, presented by Prof. Sanjiv Shah; this is the binary event the stock is currently pricing.

catalysts.label: Database lock and 6MWD primary endpoint readout
catalysts.detail: Company guidance (reaffirmed in the Q2 2026 update) calls for database lock and statistical analysis on the primary 6-minute walk distance endpoint ahead of the ESC presentation; the trial enrolled over 230 patients and is powered above 90% to detect a 25-meter 6MWD change.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 global trial enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, ex-US LEVEL-2 registrational Phase 3 trial of oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF, initiated in December 2025, is ongoing, with enrollment completion targeted by the end of 2027 ahead of a potential NDA filing.

catalysts.label: Projected cash runway expiration
catalysts.detail: Following $13.4 million in warrant-exercise proceeds during Q2 2026, management now guides that its $118.0 million cash balance funds operations through at least the first quarter of 2028, covering the LEVEL data readout and continued LEVEL-2 enrollment.

pulse: Tenax Therapeutics is in the final stretch before its make-or-break Phase 3 LEVEL readout for oral levosimendan in PH-HFpEF, with topline data now pinned to a late-breaking ESC Congress presentation on August 29, 2026. Sell-side sentiment has turned increasingly bullish into the catalyst -- Evercore ISI and Canaccord Genuity both initiated coverage in July with Buy/Outperform ratings and price targets of $39 and $35, and Guggenheim lifted its probability-of-success estimate to 80% -- while a new long-term Orion supply agreement (license extended to 2035) and a Q2 2026 report confirming cash runway into Q2 2028 add further confidence signals. With the stock trading near its highs ahead of the data, TENX remains essentially a leveraged bet on the late-August LEVEL results.
